garment.name: headgear, headgear, mo nä pälwáwwe [[Textil]]
garment.title: headgear, headgear, mo nä pälwáwwe [[Textil]]
garment.reason: The image shows a fringed headdress/roach-type ornament made from dyed deer hair (red and black) with cotton cord ties — a documented Shawnee-worn regalia item, collected directly from a named Shawnee source (Claud Tynes). This is plausible, traditional Shawnee attire despite a conflicting later museum classification tag reading "kickapoo."
